root_cause_label: knowledge_gap about Zork 1 item locations and game map causes all automated scripts to fail; agent never explores interactively or looks up a verified walkthrough
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent lacks correct knowledge of Zork 1 item locations and navigation paths, causing every automated command script to fail with 'You can't see any X here!' errors across seven iterations with no successful recovery.
t_err_evidence: Step 2: The agent creates a speedrun script with items in wrong locations (e.g., 'get lamp' in the forest at Clearing/Forest east, 'get egg' and 'get trophy' in underground areas via incorrect routes), based on unverified assumptions about Zork 1's map rather than actually exploring or looking up the correct walkthrough.
t_commit_evidence: Step 5: First full execution of the automated script shows comprehensive failure — 'You can't see any lamp here!', 'You can't go that way.' repeated six times, 'You can't see any egg here!', 'You can't see any trophy here!', ending with 'You don't have that!' — confirming the knowledge-gap approach is locked in; the agent continues the same write-then-run-wrong-script loop through step 16 without ever exploring interactively or obtaining a correct walkthrough.
t_surface_evidence: Step 5: Terminal output shows 'You can't see any lamp here!', repeated 'You can't go that way.' errors, 'You can't see any egg here!', 'You can't see any trophy here!', and final 'You don't have that!' — all unambiguous observable failure signals indicating the script is entirely wrong.
trigger_explanation: The agent does not know the correct Zork 1 game map: item locations (lamp is in the living room inside the house, not in the forest; egg is in a tree in the forest; the grating requires navigating south from the house to a specific location), navigation routes, and required prerequisites (key for the grate, entering the house through the window). Without this domain knowledge, every script the agent writes sends the player to wrong locations.
forewarning_evidence: Step 3: 'cannot open zork_speedrun.txt: No such file' error signals the agent is not tracking working directory state. Step 5: First actual gameplay reveals the entire script is wrong with 'You can't see any lamp here!' at move 5 and repeated 'You can't go that way.' errors — both signals appear strictly before the pattern becomes fully entrenched after step 5.
